title: amphinomia lupinifolia var. villosa
intro: Amphinomia lupinifolia var. villosa, commonly known as hairy sea lavender, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in soothing skin irritations and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Amphinomia lupinifolia var. villosa include its ability to act as a demulcent, protecting the skin and mucous membranes from irritation and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
